evidence.claim: ICA ha sede a Civitanova Marche, dal dicembre 2022 fa parte della divisione legno di Sherwin Williams e spedisce da filiali in Italia e all'estero.
evidence.quote: ICA is a large Italian company with headquarters in Civitanova Marche (Macerata). In December 2022, it joined the wood division of The Sherwin-Williams Company || stock is sent out to the depots and branches (which are located both within Italy and further afield)
